name: play
description: Plays a track immediately (clears the queue). Resolves plain text search queries or plays from local cache. Pass the user's requested song title/artist directly.

query.description: A plain text search query (e.g., 'Rick Astley Never Gonna Give You Up' or 'classical jazz').

name: play_next
description: Queues a track at the very front of the queue to be played immediately after the current song finishes.

query.description: A plain text search query (e.g., 'Blinding Lights').

name: pause
description: Pauses current media playback.

name: resume
description: Resumes paused media playback. Use this when the user says just 'play' or 'resume' without naming a song.

name: stop
description: Stops all playback and fully clears the playback state, queue, and autoplay pool.

name: next
description: Skips the current track and advances to the next track in the queue or autoplay pool.

name: previous
description: Returns playback to the previous track from history.

name: volume
description: Sets the speaker volume level (0-100).

name: mute
description: Mutes the speaker by setting the volume to 0. To unmute, call volume with the level the user wants.

name: autoplay
description: Enables or disables autoplay recommendations when the manual queue runs dry.

enabled.description: Set to true to enable autoplay, or false to disable it.

name: set_caching
description: Enables or disables downloading and saving live music streams to the SD card cache during playback. When disabled, playback streams directly for fastest response.

enabled.description: Set to true to enable caching music to SD card, or false to disable caching (pure live streaming).

name: write_file
description: Saves a text note to the device's notes folder on the SD card, replacing the note if it already exists. Use a short file name such as 'shopping.txt'.

path.description: Note file name, e.g. 'shopping.txt' (letters, digits, '-', '_' and '.' only; no folders).

content.description: Text content to write into the file.

name: read_file
description: Reads a text note previously saved in the device's notes folder.

name: list_notes
description: Lists the saved notes: file name, size and when each was last changed.

name: append_note
description: Adds text to the end of a note, on a new line; creates the note if it doesn't exist.

name: delete_note
description: Deletes a saved note. Confirm with the user first.

name: set_led_strip
description: Configures the solid status color of the RGB LED ring (for system idle states).

name: stop_active_alarm
description: Stops the alarm or timer that is ringing (or snoozed).

name: snooze_alarm
description: Snoozes the alarm or timer that is ringing; it rings again after its snooze time (9 minutes unless set otherwise).

name: set_alarm
description: Sets an alarm at hour:minute local time (24-hour clock). One-time unless repeat days are given. An alarm at the same time and days is updated instead of duplicated. Returns the id and when it rings next.

days.description: Repeat days: 'once' (default), 'daily', 'weekdays', 'weekends', or day names like 'mon, wed, fri'.

day.description: For a one-time item: 'today', 'tomorrow', a day name, or YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the next time the clock shows hour:minute.

tone.description: Optional song from the device's music library to ring with (title or artist). Default: the built-in alarm tone.

enabled.description: False to create or keep the alarm switched off. Default true.

name: list_alarms
description: Lists the alarms and running timers with their ids, times, repeat days and when each rings next.

name: cancel_alarm
description: Deletes an alarm or timer by id (get ids from list_alarms).

name: set_timer
description: Starts a countdown timer that rings like an alarm when it ends.

seconds.description: Duration in seconds, e.g. 1200 for 20 minutes. At most 24 hours.

name: set_reminder
description: Sets a reminder: at the time, the device chimes and you will be asked to tell the user the text. Give either in_minutes, or hour and minute (with optional day or repeat days).

text.description: What to remind the user of, e.g. 'call the bank'.

days.description: Repeat days: 'once' (default), 'daily', 'weekdays', 'weekends', or day names like 'mon, wed, fri'.

day.description: For a one-time item: 'today', 'tomorrow', a day name, or YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the next time the clock shows hour:minute.

in_minutes.description: Instead of hour and minute: remind this many minutes from now.

name: list_reminders
description: Lists the reminders with their ids, times, repeat days and whether any are pending (fired but not yet heard by the user).

name: cancel_reminder
description: Deletes a reminder by id (get ids from list_reminders).

name: acknowledge_reminders
description: Marks all pending reminders as heard. Use when the user says they got them or have done them.

name: save_to_memory
description: Appends the specified information to the device's persistent long-term memory file. Use this when the user explicitly asks you to remember something, or when you learn important personal facts, preferences, or notes about the user.

text.description: The exact fact, preference, or note to be appended to the memory file.
